department: Department of Chemistry (Graduate School of Arts and Sciences)

deadline.value: PhD applications are due December 1; the GSAS portal opens October 1.
deadline.quote: The deadline for PhD Applications is December 1.

gre_general.value: The General GRE is not considered.
gre_general.quote: No, the Chemistry Graduate Admissions committee will not consider scores from the General GRE exam.

gre_subject.value: The Graduate School requires GRE scores only from a few programs, and Chemistry is not one of them.
gre_subject.quote: Applicants to all other programs are not required to submit GRE scores.

supervisor.value: You apply to the program, not to a lab; you may list up to three faculty of interest but are not bound by them.
supervisor.quote: applicants apply to the Graduate Chemistry Program, not to a particular lab

funding.value: Doctoral students get at least five years of support, including a 12-month stipend of $37,260 and tuition remission.
funding.quote: The Graduate School offers doctoral students a minimum of five years of financial support upon admission, including twelve-month living support of $37,260

entry_route.value: Applicants with a bachelor's in chemistry, biochemistry or an allied discipline are considered; a master's is not mentioned as required.
entry_route.quote: In addition to applicants with bachelor degrees in chemistry or biochemistry, candidates with degrees in allied disciplines

notes: Dept confirms TOEFL 90 / IELTS 7.0 each section and $85 fee, same as the Graduate School; dept cannot give fee waivers itself.
